page.overview:
Who is Al-Owal?

Al-Owal was a member of the League of Assassins who trained Malcolm Merlyn in many forms of martial arts.

For his last assignment, he was tasked with returning Sara Lance to Nanda Parbat. However, in his attempt to do so, he was killed by her.
